  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)

  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)

  - comment: Finance DB confirms Karen Sloan (E043) has role Payroll Specialist. She is a full-time employee (confirmed by HR/IT notes). Her role owns the Payroll system, so admin is permitted under policy; requested level is admin, so grant admin.
Note 4 (ticket 1), written by Compliance agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Compliance DB confirms Karen Sloan (E043) has role Payroll Specialist. She is full-time (per prior HR/IT/Finance notes). The Payroll Specialist role owns the Payroll system, so admin is permitted for a full-time employee under policy. Requested level is admin, so grant admin.
Note 5 (ticket 1), written by Facilities agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Facilities DB confirms Karen Sloan (E043) has role Payroll Specialist. She is a full-time employee (per prior HR/IT notes). The Payroll Specialist role owns the Payroll system, so admin is permitted for a full-time employee under policy. Requested level is admin, so recommend granting admin.
Note 6 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - role: Payroll Specialist (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent, note 5 by Facilities agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Karen Sloan (E043) is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Requested admin exceeds the maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: The Security agent verified in their own database that Karen Sloan (E043) is a contractor with basic security training. Under policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training, and never admin. Her requested level (admin) exceeds the maximum permitted (read, since she lacks advanced training), so the maximum of read is granted.
